dryRunMaxHours.label: How fresh the dry run must be (hours)
dryRunMaxHours.help: The switch to the new ERP model goes only after a dry run this recent that saw the same list from the ERP. If the ERP's list changed since, run the dry run again.

queuedV5Orders.label: Orders still waiting in the old form at the switch
queuedV5Orders.help: An order that never reached the ERP before the switch: send it again in the new form (one line per piece), like any new order, or keep it for a person to send from the ERP link page.

mode.label: How this store switches to the new ERP contract
mode.help: Fresh start (as it ships): the ERP does not move old website orders and has no cost of goods for the days before, so the store starts clean on the switch day: no moved orders, an opening balance of 0, no transfer, no days filled before. The owner, his PIN, a dry run and the date typed back stay. The ERP's list: the earlier way, for an ERP that sends the moved orders and the cost of goods.

listShown.label: Rows in each list of the ERP link page
listShown.help: How many waiting orders, summaries and calls each list on the ERP link page shows.

demoBaseUrl.label: Demo ERP address
demoBaseUrl.help: The demo ERP the acceptance check runs against every night and before every release, once the demo shop key is saved. https only.

timeoutSeconds.label: Wait for each demo ERP answer (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: How long the acceptance check waits for one answer from the demo ERP.

demoWrites.label: Let the acceptance check write to the demo ERP
demoWrites.help: Off: against the demo ERP only the reading checks run. On: it also places its own sample orders, deliveries, return lists, summaries and fixed costs there (their ids start with ACC-). The practice ERP always runs every check.
